title: Add signed GitHub webhook endpoint with input validation
body: New endpoint validates all external input and verifies HMAC signatures.

title: Database migration for orders table with rollback plan
body: Adds a reversible schema migration and documents the rollback and forward-fix path.

title: Add structured logging with correlation id and traces
body: Every request emits structured logs with a correlation id; workflow spans added.

title: Require human approval and audit record for regulated release
body: Adds human-in-the-loop approval and a tamper-evident audit record for regulated changes.

title: Add rate limiting and health checks to deployment rollout
body: Protects shared services with rate limits and adds health checks for safe rollout.

title: Move secrets out of logs and enforce server-side authorization
body: Secrets are no longer logged; authorization checks enforced server-side.
